\section*{SELECTED PROJECTS}

\textbf{Market Trend Forecasting with LSTM and Attention Baselines.} \hfill 10/2025 -- 12/2025.\\
\textit{Course Project -- Introduction to Machine Learning (Grade: 9.5/10).} \hfill \href{https://github.com/username/project-lstm}{[GitHub Repository]}
\begin{itemize}
    \item Formulated a sequence-to-sequence prediction problem over 5 years of daily financial time-series data.
    \item Implemented linear baseline, standard LSTM, and single-head attention mechanisms from scratch using PyTorch.
    \item Enforced strict train/validation/test chronological splits to eliminate future information leakage. Observed a 14\% MAE reduction over the moving average baseline.
    \item Identified failure cases during high-volatility shocks and proposed rolling window z-score re-normalization.
\end{itemize}

\vspace{3pt}
\textbf{Reliable Vision Classification Under Controlled Image Perturbations.} \hfill 08/2025 -- 09/2025.\\
\textit{Independent Exploration Project.} \hfill \href{https://github.com/username/reliable-vision-eval}{[GitHub Repository]}
\begin{itemize}
    \item Evaluated ResNet-50 and MobileNetV2 under simulated distribution shifts (Gaussian noise, contrast reduction, blur).
    \item Measured performance drops using top-1 accuracy and expected calibration error (ECE). Found MobileNetV2 suffered 2.1x higher calibration drift under contrast shifts.
    \item Implemented test-time augmentation (TTA) pipeline that recovered 6.4\% top-1 accuracy without model retraining.
\end{itemize}
